WORKING NOTES

- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy
honey-blonde hair stands full-length against a black
backdrop with her arms crossed. She wears a fitted
purple velvet long-sleeve top, layered silver chains
with a round pendant, and a patterned mini skirt
with a sage waistband. Purple knit leg warmers and
lace-up ankle boots complete the look. A patterned
scarf hangs from one side. Her expression is calm
and direct. Soft, focused studio light. Palette of
orchid, sage, and deep black. Playful and vintage,
in the style of a 1990s grunge lookbook.
